review.finding: complete pre-signature DRBG state-rollback witness recovery
review.objective: disprove or narrow the claimed attack
review.accepted_claim: Two valid signatures under one key on distinct messages recover an equivalent R-SDP signing witness and permit a fresh-message forgery after complete pre-signature DRBG state rollback to the same state immediately before both signing calls, thereby repeating both the hidden master_seed and public Salt; repetition of either value alone is insufficient.
review.excluded_claim: No ordinary fresh-randomness EUF-CMA break is established.

normative_inputs.archive_comparison: Core sources match a fresh archive extraction; the release omits only two archive-provided executable files.

mathematical_audit.public_relation: eta in Z_7^n, e=2^eta, e H^T=s
mathematical_audit.cross_branch_openings: One transcript supplies a serialized type-1 Seed[i]; the other supplies the opposite type-0 v_i at the same round.
mathematical_audit.pdf_domains: rounds are one-based; independently indexed Seed[i]; expansion domain i+c
mathematical_audit.untouched_source_domains: unindexed leaf stream and zero-based round domain
mathematical_audit.wrong_domain_control: PASS for every tested complementary-opening candidate in 32 independently seeded cases

affine_fallback.condition: The fixed-weight type-1 branch vectors are identical, so all type-0 positions are shared; at least one shared position has beta_i != beta'_i.
affine_fallback.validation: Every usable real shared type-0 candidate agreed with the recovered witness; a separate equation self-test checked the fallback. Natural full-parameter trials used the cross-branch route.

mathematical_audit.candidate_consistency: The first candidate is checked against the public syndrome; every later cross-branch or affine candidate must be byte-identical to it.
mathematical_audit.complexity: O(t*n+r*k) small-field work and comparable stored transcript data, plus two ordinary signature verifications
mathematical_audit.data: two valid source signatures, public key, and two messages

rollback_audit.required_state: complete pre-signature DRBG state rollback to the same state immediately before both signing calls
rollback_audit.same_message_behavior: byte-identical deterministic replay and rejection by the public attack interface

public_interface_audit.recovered_object: eta/e, an equivalent signing witness, not the original compact Seed_sk
public_interface_audit.secret_backed_eta_comparison: producer-side assertion only; it is outside the extractor and forgery interfaces

independent_adversarial_cases.construction: 4 independent key/rollback seed pairs x 4 profiles x 2 semantics
assertions_per_case: equal Salt with a different hidden root rejects

The public package preserves REFERENCE_VALIDATION.log; the revision changed documentation, machine-readable wording, and prior-art snapshots only, so no additional large experiment was run.

ideal_probability_audit.model: Independent uniform fixed-weight type-1 branch sets B,B' of size w, plus idealized independent challenge values and optional finite digest layers.
ideal_probability_audit.qualification: These are explanatory ideal-model probabilities, not exact concrete probabilities for conditioned serialized SM3 transcripts.

specification_claim_audit.section_2_4_3: documents deterministic whole-signing-flow replay from a fixed DRBG seed
specification_claim_audit.section_3_3_4: considers complete reset across distinct messages, observes repeated round seeds and changed Fiat-Shamir challenges, and claims strong robustness under temporary DRBG-state reuse
specification_claim_audit.section_3_3_6: again characterizes the DRBG state-reuse mechanism as robust
specification_claim_audit.result_boundary: The experiment refutes only Qing Luan’s explicit robustness statements for essentially complete pre-signature DRBG state rollback; ordinary signing with fresh independent randomness is not broken.

prior_art.public_candidate_finding_at_snapshot: sign-20-1, an unrelated quantum-accounting proof gap
generic_prior_work_considered: Fiat-Shamir repeated-randomness and hedging work, including ePrint 2019/956
CROSS fault attacks, including ePrint 2024/1422 and 2025/1885
prior_art.novelty_scope: Only the Qing-Luan-specific complementary type-1 Seed[i]/type-0 v_i mechanism, its affine fallback, and its contradiction of the claimed robustness for essentially complete pre-signature DRBG state rollback.

release_defects_found_and_fixed_during_r: The initial PDF-aligned combined harness retained untouched-source witness-signer leaf/domain semantics; the sealed signer is semantics-parameterized.
The initial combined extractor selected only the first cross candidate; the sealed extractor checks every cross and affine candidate for consistency.
A wrong-message control was masked by the equal-message guard; the sealed control reaches the intended verification path.
The top-level paper was stale relative to the reproducer; sealed TeX/PDF copies are byte-identical.
The release initially mislabeled the primary novelty/results as affine-only; the sealed release distinguishes the complementary-opening mechanism and affine fallback.
The corruption control initially changed a commitment byte while prose identified y; the sealed control locates and flips a serialized type-0 y byte.
Per-candidate public relation validation contradicted the stated O(t*n+r*k) bound; the sealed extractor validates the first candidate and compares later candidates to it.
Paper control wording was narrowed to a previously queried message, matching the exercised harness.
remaining_assumptions_and_limits: The failure environment must induce complete pre-signature DRBG state rollback to the same state immediately before both signing calls.
Both signatures must use the same key and distinct messages.
Both the hidden root and public Salt must repeat; repetition of either value alone does not enable extraction.

The PDF does not fully specify integer byte encoding. The aligned experiment uses the submission's established little-endian 16-bit encoding; the algebra is encoding-independent when signer, verifier, and public expansion agree.
The identical-second-challenge affine fallback was not sampled naturally at full parameters; its equation was checked on real shared type-0 positions and with an independent self-test.
Ideal fixed-weight and layered-hash calculations are not concrete conditioned-transcript probabilities.
A prior-art search cannot prove novelty.
final_comment: No remaining mathematical, specification-conformance, public-interface, or harness-artifact objection falsified the narrow conditional complete-pre-signature-DRBG-state-rollback result.
